   {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Star className=\"w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">Sign in to write a review</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reviewDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-6\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-bold text-lg\">Review submitted!</p>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1\">It will appear after admin approval.</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-5\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-3 text-center\">How would you rate this game?</p>\r\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-center gap-2\">\r\n                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                        <button key={s} type=\"button\"\r\n                          onMouseEnter={() => setReviewHover(s)} onMouseLeave={() => setReviewHover(0)}\r\n                          onClick={() => setReviewRating(s)}\r\n                          className=\"transition-transform hover:scale-125\">\r\n                          <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${s <= (reviewHover || reviewRating) ?               "newString": "export async function PATCH(req: NextRequest) {\n  const token = req.headers.get('authorization')?.replace('Bearer ', '')\n  const user = token ? await getUserByToken(token) : null\n  const { id, status, rating, content } = await req.json()\n  \n  // If updating user's own pending review\n  if (user && id && (rating !== undefined || content !== undefined)) {\n    const { data: existing } = await supabase.from('game_reviews')\n      .select('id, user_id, status').eq('id', id).single()\n    \n    if (existing && existing.user_id === user.id && existing.status === 'pending') {\n      const updateData: any = {}\n      if (rating !== undefined) updateData.rating = rating\n      if (content !== undefined) updateData.content = content?.trim() || null\n      await supabase.from('game_reviews').update(updateData).eq('id', id)\n      return NextResponse.json({ success: true })\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Otherwise, admin is updating status\n  await supabase.from('game_reviews').update({ status }).eq('id', id)\n  return NextResponse.json({ success: true })\n}"

          <div className=\"py-8\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-lg font-medium mb-2\">No reviews               "content": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { useEffect, useState, useCallback } from \"react\"\n\ninterface ToastData {\n  id: number\n  message: string\n  type: 'success' | 'info' | 'error'\n  duration: number\n}\n\nlet toastId = 0\nconst listeners: Set<(toasts: ToastData[]) => void> = new Set()\n\nexport function showToast(message: string, type: 'success' | 'info' | 'error' = 'info', duration: number = 4000) {\n  const id = ++toastId\n  const listener = [...listeners][0]\n  if (listener) {\n    listener([{ id, message, type, duration }])\n  }\n  setTimeout(() => {\n    const listener = [...listeners][0]\n    if (listener) {\n      listener([])\n    }\n  }, duration)\n}\n\nexport function ToastContainer() {\n  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<ToastData[]>([])\n  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(false)\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    listeners.add(setToasts)\n    return () => { listeners.delete(setToasts) }\n  }, [])\n\n  const handleRemove = useCallback(() => {\n    setRemoving(true)\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setToasts([])\n      setRemoving(false)\n    }, 300)\n  }, [])\n\n  if (toasts.length === 0) return null\n\n  const toast = toasts[0]\n\n  return (\n    <div \n      className={`fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[300] transition-all duration-300 ${\n        removing ? 'opacity-0 translate-y-4' : 'opacity-100 translate-y-0'\n      }`}\n    >\n      <div \n        className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl text-white text-sm font-semibold min-w-[300px] ${\n          toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-600' : toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-600' : 'bg-[#9d4edd]'\n        }`}\n        style={{ border: \"1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)\" }}\n      >\n        <span>{toast.type === 'success' ? '✓' : toast.type === 'error' ? '✕' : '⏳'}</span>\n        <span className=\"flex-1\">{toast.message}</span>\n        <button onClick={handleRemove} className=\"ml-2 opacity-70 hover:opacity-100\">✕</button>\n      </div>\n      {/* Progress bar */}\n      <div className=\"mt-2 h-1 bg-white/20 rounded-full overflow-hidden\">\n        <div \n          className={`h-full rounded-full ${\n            toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-green-400' : toast.type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-400' : 'bg-[#c77dff]'\n          }`}\n          style={{ \n            animation: `shrink ${toast.duration}ms linear forwards`,\n          }}\n        />\n      </div>\n      <style jsx>{`\n        @keyframes shrink {\n          from { width: 100%; }\n          to { width: 0%; }\n        }\n      `}</style>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"

              "filediff": {
                "file": "C:\\wd\\Rovo Dev\\web2\\components\\comments.tsx",
                "before": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \"react\"\nimport { MessageSquare, ThumbsUp, ThumbsDown, Reply, LogIn, Send } from \"lucide-react\"\nimport { useUser } from \"@/lib/user-context\"\nimport { PLAN_BADGES } from \"@/lib/usernames\"\nimport Link from \"next/link\"\n\ninterface Comment {\n  id: number\n  author: string\n  content: string\n  timestamp: string\n  likes: number\n  dislikes: number\n  user_badge?: string\n  user_badge_color?: string\n  replies?: Comment[]\n}\n\ninterface CommentsProps {\n  gameId: number\n  itemName: string\n}\n\nfunction formatTimestamp(ts: string) {\n  const d = new Date(ts), now = new Date()\n  const diff = Math.floor((now.getTime() - d.getTime()) / 1000)\n  if (diff < 60) return 'just now'\n  if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}m ago`\n  if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h ago`\n  if (diff < 604800) return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)}d ago`\n  return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' })\n}\n\nfunction UserBadge({ badge, color }: { badge?: string; color?: string }) {\n  if (!badge) return null\n  return (\n    <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${color || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400 border-gray-500/30'}`}>\n      {badge}\n    </span>\n  )\n}\n\nexport function Comments({ gameId, itemName }: CommentsProps) {\n  const { user, token } = useUser() || {}\n  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([])\n  const [newComment, setNewComment] = useState(\"\")\n  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)\n  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false)\n  const [replyingTo, setReplyingTo] = useState<number | null>(null)\n  const [replyContent, setReplyContent] = useState(\"\")\n  const [isAdmin, setIsAdmin] = useState(false)\n\n  const planBadge = user ? PLAN_BADGES[(user as any).subscription_plan || 'free'] : null\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    try { setIsAdmin(localStorage.getItem(\"admin_token\") === \"authenticated\") } catch {}\n    fetch(`/api/comments?itemId=${gameId}`, { cache: 'no-store' })\n      .then(r => r.json()).then(d => { if (d.success) setComments(d.data || []) }).catch(() => {})\n  }, [gameId])\n\n  const apiPost = async (body: object) => {\n    const res = await fetch('/api/comments', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) })\n    const json = await res.json()\n    if (json.success) setComments(json.data)\n    return json\n  }\n\n  const handleSubmit = async () => {\n    if (!newComment.trim() || !user) return\n    setSubmitting(true)\n    await apiPost({\n      action: 'add', itemId: gameId, itemName,\n      author: user.name, email: (user as any).email || '', content: newComment.trim(),\n      userBadge: planBadge?.label, userBadgeColor: planBadge?.color,\n    })\n    setNewComment(\"\")\n    setSubmitting(false)\n    setSubmitted(true)\n    // Show toast notification\n    showToast('Your comment has been submitted and is awaiting admin approval.', 'info')\n    setTimeout(() => setSubmitted(false), 4000)\n  }\n\n  const showToast = (msg: string, type: 'success' | 'info' = 'info') => {\n    const toast = document.getElementById('global-toast')\n    if (toast) {\n      toast.textContent = msg\n      toast.className = `fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-[300] flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-all animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 ${type === 'success' ? </div>\n        <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 mt-1.5 px-1\">\n          <button onClick={() => handleReact(c.id, 'like')} className=\"flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-green-400 transition-colors text-xs group\">\n            <ThumbsUp className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform\" /> {c.likes > 0 && c.likes}\n          </button>\n          <button onClick={() => handleReact(c.id, 'dislike')} className=\"flex items-center gap-1 text-gray-500 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors text-xs group\">\n            <ThumbsDown className=\"w-3.5 h-3.5 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform\" /> {c.dislikes > 0 && c.dislikes}\n          </button>\n          {!isReply && user && (\n            <button onClick={() => Reply\n            </button>\n          )}\n          {isAdmin && (\n            <button onClick={() => handleDelete(c.id)} className=\"text-gray-600 hover:text-red-400 transition-colors text-xs ml-auto\">Delete</button>\n          )}\n        </div>\n\n        {replyingTo === c.id && (\n          <div className=\"mt-2 flex gap-2\">\n            <textarea value={replyContent} onChange={e => setReplyContent(e.target.value)} rows={2} placeholder=\"Write a reply...\"\n              className=\"flex-1 bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] focus:border-[#9d4edd] rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white       </h2>\n        {comments.length > 0 && <span className=\"text-gray-500 text-xs\">Share your thoughts</span>}\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Comment input */}\n      {!user ? 'w-7 h-7 text-xs' : 'w-9 h-9 text-sm'} rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#9d4edd]/40 to-[#7b2cbf]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold flex-shrink-0 ring-1 text-lg\">Player Perspectives</h3>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"p-6\">\r\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{averageRating.toFixed(1)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Average Score</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-green-400 mb-1\">{recommendPercent}%</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Recommend</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{DownloadsFormatter(downloads)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Downloads</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{views.toLocaleString()}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Views</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 mt-4 relative\">\r\n            <div className=\"relative\">\r\n              <Button\r\n                variant=\"outline\"\r\n                className={`border-white/20 transition-colors ${userReaction === 'like' ? 'text-green-400 border-green-500/50 bg-green-500/10' : 'text-foreground hover:bg-white/10'}`}\r\n                onClick={() => handleReaction('like')}\r\n              >\r\n                <ThumbsUp className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${userReaction === 'like' ? 'fill-green-400' : ''}`} />\r\n                Like {likes > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-xs\">{likes}</span>}\r\n              </Button>\r\n              {showReactionLoginPrompt && (\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-2 bg-[#120b22] border border-[#9d4edd]/40 rounded-lg text-xs text-white whitespace-nowrap shadow-xl z-50\">\r\n                  <a href=\"/login\" className=\"text-[#9d4edd] font-semibold hover:underline\">Login</a> or <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"text-[#9d4edd] font-semibold hover:underline\">Sign up</a> to react\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n            <Button\r\n              variant=\"outline\"\r\n              className={`border-white/20 transition-colors ${userReaction === 'dislike' ? 'text-red-400 border-red-500/50 bg-red-500/10' : 'text-foreground hover:bg-white/10'}`}\r\n              onClick={() => handleReaction('dislike')}\r\n            >\r\n              <ThumbsDown className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${userReaction === 'dislike' ? 'fill-red-400' : ''}`} />\r\n              Dislike {dislikes > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-xs\">{dislikes}</span>}\r\n            </Button>\r\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" className=\"border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10\" onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}>\r\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              Write Review\r\n            </Button>\r\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" className=\"border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 hover:border-red-500/30\" onClick={() => setShowReportModal(true)}>\r\n              <Flag className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              Report\r\n            </Button>\r\n          </div>        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Note */}\r\n      {\r\n        game.note && (\r\n          <div className=\"bg-yellow-500/10 rounded-2xl\">\r\n            <div className=\"p-4\">\r\n              <h3 className=\"text-yellow-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-2 mb-2\">\r\n                <AlertTriangle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\r\n                Note\r\n              </h3>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">{game.note}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Related Games */}\r\n      {\r\n        allGames.length > 0 && (() => {\r\n          const gameGenres = game.genres || []\r\n          const gameFeatures = (game.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || game.features || [])\r\n            .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n          const gameCategory = game.category\r\n\r\n          // Score each game by genre + feature overlap\r\n          const scored = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .map(g => {\r\n              const gGenres = g.genres || []\r\n              const gFeatures = (g.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || g.features || [])\r\n                .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n              const genreScore = gGenres.filter((genre: string) => gameGenres.includes(genre)).length * 2\r\n              const featureScore = gFeatures.filter((f: string) =>\r\n                gameFeatures.some(mf => mf.includes(f) || f.includes(mf))\r\n              ).length\r\n              return { ...g, score: genreScore + featureScore }\r\n            })\r\n            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)\r\n\r\n          const related = scored.slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          // Top in same category by rating\r\n          const topInCategory = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .sort((a, b) => (Number(b.rating) || 0) - (Number(a.rating) || 0))\r\n            .slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          if (related.length === 0 && topInCategory.length === 0) return null\r\n\r\n          const GameCard = ({ g, index }: { g: any; index?: number }) => (\r\n            <Link key={g.id} href={`/game/${g.id}`} className=\"group flex-shrink-0 w-28 sm:w-32\">\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#1a103c]\">\r\n                <img\r\n                  src={g.image || \"/placeholder.svg\"}\r\n                  alt={g.title}\r\n                  className=\"w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110\"\r\n                />\r\n                {index !== undefined && index < 3 && (\r\n                  <div className={`absolute top-1.5 left-1.5 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${index === 0 ? \"bg-yellow-500\" : index === 1 ? \"bg-gray-400\" : \"bg-amber-700\"}`}>\r\n                    {index + 1}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n                <div className={`absolute ${index !== undefined && index < 3 ? 'top-1.5 right-1.5' : 'top-1.5 left-1.5'} px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-white text-[8px] font-bold uppercase shadow-lg z-10 ${g.category === \"Android Games\" ? \"bg-green-500/90\" : \"bg-blue-500/90\"}`}>\r\n                  {g.category === \"Android Games\" ? \"APK\" : \"PC\"}\r\n                </div>\r\n                <div className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\" />\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\">\r\n                  <p className=\"text-white text-[10px] font-medium line-clamp-2\">{g.title}</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1.5 line-clamp-1 group-hover:text-[#9d4edd] transition-colors\">{g.title}</p>\r\n            </Link>\r\n          )\r\n\r\n          return (\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\r\n              {related.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-[#9d4edd] rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Related Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {related.map(g => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n\r\n              {topInCategory.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Top {gameCategory === \"Android Games\" ? \"Android\" : \"PC\"} Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {topInCategory.map((g, i) => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} index={i} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          )\r\n        })()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Ratings & Reviews Section - Always visible */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2\">\r\n            <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n              Ratings & Reviews\r\n              <span className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm font-normal\">({reviews.length})</span>\r\n            </h3>\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <span className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-500/20 border border-yellow-500/50 text-yellow-400\">\r\n                  Pending Approval\r\n                </span>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={withdrawReview}\r\n                  className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/50 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/30\"\r\n                >\r\n                  Withdraw\r\n                </button>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={updateReview}\r\n                  className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-blue-500/20 border border-blue-500/50 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/30\"\r\n                >\r\n                  Edit\r\n                </button>\r\n              )}\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${\r\n                  userReview && userReview.status !== 'pending'\r\n                    ? 'bg-green-500/20 border border-green-500/50 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/30' \r\n                    : 'bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white'\r\n                }`}\r\n              >\r\n                {userReview ? `Rated: ${userReview.rating} ★` : 'Write a Review'}\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n        \r\n        {reviews.length > 0 ? (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 space-y-4\">\r\n            {/* Average */}\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-xl\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n                <p className=\"text-4xl font-black text-white\">{(reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1)}</p>\r\n                <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-1 justify-center\">\r\n                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-4 h-4 ${s <= Math.round(reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                </div>\r\n                <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1\">{reviews.length} review{reviews.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>\r\n                {userReview && (\r\n                  <div className=\"mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10\">\r\n                    <p className=\"text-green-400 text-xs font-medium\">Your Rating: {userReview.rating} ★</p>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n              <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-1\">\r\n                {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(star => {\r\n                  const count = reviews.filter(r => r.rating === star).length\r\n                  const pct = reviews.length ? Math.round((count / reviews.length) * 100) : 0\r\n                  return (\r\n                    <div key={star} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-xs\">\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-400 w-3\">{star}</span>\r\n                      <Star className=\"w-3 h-3 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n                      <div className=\"flex-1 bg-[#1a103c] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden\">\r\n                        <div className=\"h-full bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-500 w-6 text-right\">{count}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )\r\n                })}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            {/* Individual reviews */}\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-3\">\r\n                {reviews.map(r => (\r\n                  <div key={r.id} className=\"bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-xl p-4\">\r\n                    <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2\">\r\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                        <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#9d4edd]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold\">{r.user_name?.charAt(0)}</div>\r\n                        <div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\r\n                            <p className=\"text-white text-sm font-semibold\">{r.user_name}</p>\r\n                            {r.user_badge && (\r\n                              <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${r.user_badge_color || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400 border-gray-500/30'}`}>\r\n                                {r.user_badge}\r\n                              </span>\r\n                            )}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-0.5\">\r\n                            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-3 h-3 ${s <= r.rating ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs\">{new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {r.content && <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm leading-relaxed\">{r.content}</p>}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        ) : (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 text-center\">\r\n            <div className=\"py-8\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-lg font-medium mb-2\">No reviews yet</p>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mb-4\">Be the first to share your experience!</p>\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className=\"px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white transition-colors\"\r\n              >\r\n                Write a Review\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )}\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Comments */}\r\n      <Comments gameId={game.id} itemName={game.title} />\r\n\r\n      {/* Review Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReviewModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-5\">\r\n                <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\"><Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500\" /> Rate & Review</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Star className=\"w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">Sign in to write a review</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reviewDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-6\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-bold text-lg\">Review submitted!</p>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1\">It will appear after admin approval.</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-5\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-3 text-center\">How would you rate this game?</p>\r\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-center gap-2\">\r\n                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                        <button key={s} type=\"button\"\r\n                          onMouseEnter={() => setReviewHover(s)} onMouseLeave={() => setReviewHover(0)}\r\n                          onClick={() => setReviewRating(s)}\r\n                          className=\"transition-transform hover:scale-125\">\r\n                          <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${s <= (reviewHover || reviewRating) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />\r\n                        </button>\r\n                      ))}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {reviewRating > 0 && (\r\n                      <p className=\"text-center text-sm mt-2 font-semibold\" style={{ color: ['', '#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'][reviewRating] }}>\r\n                        {['', 'Terrible', 'Poor', 'Average', 'Good', 'Excellent'][reviewRating]}\r\n                      </p>\r\n                    )}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1.5 block\">Share your experience <span className=\"text-gray-600\">(optional)</span></label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reviewContent} onChange={e => setReviewContent(e.target.value)} rows={4}\r\n                      placeholder=\"What did you think about this game? Any tips for other players?\"\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] focus:border-[#9d4edd] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none transition-colors text-sm resize-none\" />\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <button onClick={submitReview} disabled={reviewSubmitting || !reviewRating}\r\n                    className=\"w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-white transition-all disabled:opacity-40 hover:scale-[1.01]\"\r\n                    style={{ background: \"linear-gradient(135deg, #9d4edd, #7b2cbf)\" }}>\r\n                    {reviewSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit Review'}\r\n                  </button>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs text-center\">Reviews are shown after admin approval</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Trailer Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        trailerOpen && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/95 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setTrailerOpen(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-4xl\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <button onClick={() => setTrailerOpen(false)} className=\"absolute -top-10 right-0 text-white/80 hover:text-white text-2xl font-bold z-10 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                <X className=\"w-6 h-6\" /> Close\r\n              </button>\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black shadow-2xl\">\r\n                {trailerYtId ? (\r\n                  <iframe\r\n                    src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${trailerYtId}?autoplay=1`}\r\n                    className=\"w-full h-full\"\r\n                    allow=\"autoplay; fullscreen\"\r\n                    allowFullScreen\r\n                  />\r\n                ) : (\r\n                  <video src={game.trailerUrl} controls autoPlay className=\"w-full h-full\" />\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Report Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReportModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setShowReportModal(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\">\r\n                <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold flex items-center gap-2\"><Flag className=\"w-4 h-4 text-red-400\" /> Report Issue</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReportModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Flag className=\"w-10 h-10 text-red-400 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">You need to be logged in to report an issue.</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reportDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-10 h-10 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-2\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-semibold\">Report submitted!</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-4\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1 block\">Report Type</label>\r\n                    <select value={reportType} onChange={e => setReportType(e.target.value)}\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#9d4edd]\">\r\n                      <option value=\"error\">Download Error</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"broken_link\">Broken Link</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"wrong_game\">Wrong Game</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"virus\">Virus/Malware</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"other\">Other</option>\r\n                    </select>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1 block\">Description *</label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reportDesc} onChange={e => setReportDesc(e.target.value)} rows={3}\r\n text-lg\">Player Perspectives</h3>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"p-6\">\r\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{averageRating.toFixed(1)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Average Score</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-green-400 mb-1\">{recommendPercent}%</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Recommend</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{DownloadsFormatter(downloads)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Downloads</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{views.toLocaleString()}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Views</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 mt-4 relative\">\r\n            <div className=\"relative\">\r\n              <Button\r\n                variant=\"outline\"\r\n                className={`border-white/20 transition-colors ${userReaction === 'like' ? 'text-green-400 border-green-500/50 bg-green-500/10' : 'text-foreground hover:bg-white/10'}`}\r\n                onClick={() => handleReaction('like')}\r\n              >\r\n                <ThumbsUp className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${userReaction === 'like' ? 'fill-green-400' : ''}`} />\r\n                Like {likes > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-xs\">{likes}</span>}\r\n              </Button>\r\n              {showReactionLoginPrompt && (\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-2 bg-[#120b22] border border-[#9d4edd]/40 rounded-lg text-xs text-white whitespace-nowrap shadow-xl z-50\">\r\n                  <a href=\"/login\" className=\"text-[#9d4edd] font-semibold hover:underline\">Login</a> or <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"text-[#9d4edd] font-semibold hover:underline\">Sign up</a> to react\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n            <Button\r\n              variant=\"outline\"\r\n              className={`border-white/20 transition-colors ${userReaction === 'dislike' ? 'text-red-400 border-red-500/50 bg-red-500/10' : 'text-foreground hover:bg-white/10'}`}\r\n              onClick={() => handleReaction('dislike')}\r\n            >\r\n              <ThumbsDown className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${userReaction === 'dislike' ? 'fill-red-400' : ''}`} />\r\n              Dislike {dislikes > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-xs\">{dislikes}</span>}\r\n            </Button>\r\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" className=\"border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10\" onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}>\r\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              Write Review\r\n            </Button>\r\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" className=\"border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 hover:border-red-500/30\" onClick={() => setShowReportModal(true)}>\r\n              <Flag className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              Report\r\n            </Button>\r\n          </div>        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Note */}\r\n      {\r\n        game.note && (\r\n          <div className=\"bg-yellow-500/10 rounded-2xl\">\r\n            <div className=\"p-4\">\r\n              <h3 className=\"text-yellow-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-2 mb-2\">\r\n                <AlertTriangle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\r\n                Note\r\n              </h3>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">{game.note}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Related Games */}\r\n      {\r\n        allGames.length > 0 && (() => {\r\n          const gameGenres = game.genres || []\r\n          const gameFeatures = (game.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || game.features || [])\r\n            .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n          const gameCategory = game.category\r\n\r\n          // Score each game by genre + feature overlap\r\n          const scored = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .map(g => {\r\n              const gGenres = g.genres || []\r\n              const gFeatures = (g.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || g.features || [])\r\n                .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n              const genreScore = gGenres.filter((genre: string) => gameGenres.includes(genre)).length * 2\r\n              const featureScore = gFeatures.filter((f: string) =>\r\n                gameFeatures.some(mf => mf.includes(f) || f.includes(mf))\r\n              ).length\r\n              return { ...g, score: genreScore + featureScore }\r\n            })\r\n            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)\r\n\r\n          const related = scored.slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          // Top in same category by rating\r\n          const topInCategory = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .sort((a, b) => (Number(b.rating) || 0) - (Number(a.rating) || 0))\r\n            .slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          if (related.length === 0 && topInCategory.length === 0) return null\r\n\r\n          const GameCard = ({ g, index }: { g: any; index?: number }) => (\r\n            <Link key={g.id} href={`/game/${g.id}`} className=\"group flex-shrink-0 w-28 sm:w-32\">\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#1a103c]\">\r\n                <img\r\n                  src={g.image || \"/placeholder.svg\"}\r\n                  alt={g.title}\r\n                  className=\"w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110\"\r\n                />\r\n                {index !== undefined && index < 3 && (\r\n                  <div className={`absolute top-1.5 left-1.5 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${index === 0 ? \"bg-yellow-500\" : index === 1 ? \"bg-gray-400\" : \"bg-amber-700\"}`}>\r\n                    {index + 1}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n                <div className={`absolute ${index !== undefined && index < 3 ? 'top-1.5 right-1.5' : 'top-1.5 left-1.5'} px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-white text-[8px] font-bold uppercase shadow-lg z-10 ${g.category === \"Android Games\" ? \"bg-green-500/90\" : \"bg-blue-500/90\"}`}>\r\n                  {g.category === \"Android Games\" ? \"APK\" : \"PC\"}\r\n                </div>\r\n                <div className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\" />\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\">\r\n                  <p className=\"text-white text-[10px] font-medium line-clamp-2\">{g.title}</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1.5 line-clamp-1 group-hover:text-[#9d4edd] transition-colors\">{g.title}</p>\r\n            </Link>\r\n          )\r\n\r\n          return (\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\r\n              {related.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-[#9d4edd] rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Related Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {related.map(g => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n\r\n              {topInCategory.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Top {gameCategory === \"Android Games\" ? \"Android\" : \"PC\"} Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {topInCategory.map((g, i) => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} index={i} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          )\r\n        })()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Ratings & Reviews Section - Always visible */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2\">\r\n            <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n              Ratings & Reviews\r\n              <span className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm font-normal\">({reviews.length})</span>\r\n            </h3>\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <span className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-500/20 border border-yellow-500/50 text-yellow-400\">\r\n                  Pending Approval\r\n                </span>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={withdrawReview}\r\n                  className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/50 text-red-400 hover:bg-red-500/30\"\r\n                >\r\n                  Withdraw\r\n                </button>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={updateReview}\r\n                  className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-blue-500/20 border border-blue-500/50 text-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-500/30\"\r\n                >\r\n                  Edit\r\n                </button>\r\n              )}\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${\r\n                  userReview && userReview.status !== 'pending'\r\n                    ? 'bg-green-500/20 border border-green-500/50 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/30' \r\n                    : 'bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white'\r\n                }`}\r\n              >\r\n                {userReview ? `Rated: ${userReview.rating} ★` : 'Write a Review'}\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n        \r\n        {reviews.length > 0 ? (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 space-y-4\">\r\n            {/* Average */}\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-xl\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n                <p className=\"text-4xl font-black text-white\">{(reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1)}</p>\r\n                <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-1 justify-center\">\r\n                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-4 h-4 ${s <= Math.round(reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                </div>\r\n                <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1\">{reviews.length} review{reviews.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>\r\n                {userReview && (\r\n                  <div className=\"mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10\">\r\n                    <p className=\"text-green-400 text-xs font-medium\">Your Rating: {userReview.rating} ★</p>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n              <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-1\">\r\n                {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(star => {\r\n                  const count = reviews.filter(r => r.rating === star).length\r\n                  const pct = reviews.length ? Math.round((count / reviews.length) * 100) : 0\r\n                  return (\r\n                    <div key={star} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-xs\">\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-400 w-3\">{star}</span>\r\n                      <Star className=\"w-3 h-3 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n                      <div className=\"flex-1 bg-[#1a103c] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden\">\r\n                        <div className=\"h-full bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-500 w-6 text-right\">{count}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )\r\n                })}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            {/* Individual reviews */}\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-3\">\r\n                {reviews.map(r => (\r\n                  <div key={r.id} className=\"bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-xl p-4\">\r\n                    <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2\">\r\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                        <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#9d4edd]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold\">{r.user_name?.charAt(0)}</div>\r\n                        <div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\r\n                            <p className=\"text-white text-sm font-semibold\">{r.user_name}</p>\r\n                            {r.user_badge && (\r\n                              <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${r.user_badge_color || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400 border-gray-500/30'}`}>\r\n                                {r.user_badge}\r\n                              </span>\r\n                            )}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-0.5\">\r\n                            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-3 h-3 ${s <= r.rating ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs\">{new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {r.content && <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm leading-relaxed\">{r.content}</p>}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        ) : (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 text-center\">\r\n            <div className=\"py-8\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-lg font-medium mb-2\">No reviews yet</p>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mb-4\">Be the first to share your experience!</p>\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className=\"px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white transition-colors\"\r\n              >\r\n                Write a Review\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )}\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Comments */}\r\n      <Comments gameId={game.id} itemName={game.title} />\r\n\r\n      {/* Review Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReviewModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-5\">\r\n                <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\"><Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500\" /> Rate & Review</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Star className=\"w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">Sign in to write a review</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reviewDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-6\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-bold text-lg\">Review submitted!</p>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1\">It will appear after admin approval.</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-5\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-3 text-center\">How would you rate this game?</p>\r\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-center gap-2\">\r\n                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                        <button key={s} type=\"button\"\r\n                          onMouseEnter={() => setReviewHover(s)} onMouseLeave={() => setReviewHover(0)}\r\n                          onClick={() => setReviewRating(s)}\r\n                          className=\"transition-transform hover:scale-125\">\r\n                          <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${s <= (reviewHover || reviewRating) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />\r\n                        </button>\r\n                      ))}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {reviewRating > 0 && (\r\n                      <p className=\"text-center text-sm mt-2 font-semibold\" style={{ color: ['', '#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'][reviewRating] }}>\r\n                        {['', 'Terrible', 'Poor', 'Average', 'Good', 'Excellent'][reviewRating]}\r\n                      </p>\r\n                    )}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1.5 block\">Share your experience <span className=\"text-gray-600\">(optional)</span></label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reviewContent} onChange={e => setReviewContent(e.target.value)} rows={4}\r\n                      placeholder=\"What did you think about this game? Any tips for other players?\"\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] focus:border-[#9d4edd] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none transition-colors text-sm resize-none\" />\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <button onClick={submitReview} disabled={reviewSubmitting || !reviewRating}\r\n                    className=\"w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-white transition-all disabled:opacity-40 hover:scale-[1.01]\"\r\n                    style={{ background: \"linear-gradient(135deg, #9d4edd, #7b2cbf)\" }}>\r\n                    {reviewSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit Review'}\r\n                  </button>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs text-center\">Reviews are shown after admin approval</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Trailer Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        trailerOpen && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/95 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setTrailerOpen(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-4xl\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <button onClick={() => setTrailerOpen(false)} className=\"absolute -top-10 right-0 text-white/80 hover:text-white text-2xl font-bold z-10 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                <X className=\"w-6 h-6\" /> Close\r\n              </button>\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black shadow-2xl\">\r\n                {trailerYtId ? (\r\n                  <iframe\r\n                    src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${trailerYtId}?autoplay=1`}\r\n                    className=\"w-full h-full\"\r\n                    allow=\"autoplay; fullscreen\"\r\n                    allowFullScreen\r\n                  />\r\n                ) : (\r\n                  <video src={game.trailerUrl} controls autoPlay className=\"w-full h-full\" />\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Report Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReportModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setShowReportModal(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\">\r\n                <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold flex items-center gap-2\"><Flag className=\"w-4 h-4 text-red-400\" /> Report Issue</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReportModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Flag className=\"w-10 h-10 text-red-400 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">You need to be logged in to report an issue.</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reportDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-10 h-10 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-2\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-semibold\">Report submitted!</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-4\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1 block\">Report Type</label>\r\n                    <select value={reportType} onChange={e => setReportType(e.target.value)}\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#9d4edd]\">\r\n                      <option value=\"error\">Download Error</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"broken_link\">Broken Link</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"wrong_game\">Wrong Game</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"virus\">Virus/Malware</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"other\">Other</option>\r\n                    </select>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1 block\">Description *</label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reportDesc} onChange={e => setReportDesc(e.target.value)} rows={3}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <div className=\"p-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\r\n                        {allLinks.map((cloud, ci) => {\r\n                          const style = getCloudStyle(cloud.cloudName)\r\n                          const isExpanded = expandedCloud === ci\r\n                          const links =                        <button\r\n                                className=\"w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3\"\r\n                                onClick={() => 's' : ''}</p>}\r\n                                  </div>\r\n                                </div>\r\n                                {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className=\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-400\" />   <div className=\"border-t border-white/10 p-2 space-y-1.5\">\r\n                                  {links.map((link, li) => (\r\n                                    <a\r\n                                      key={li}\r\n                                      href={link.url}\r\n                                      target=\"_blank\"\r\n                                      rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\r\n                                      className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-black/20 rounded-lg hover:bg-black/40 transition-all\"\r\n                                    >\r\n                                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0\">\r\n                                        <Download className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${style.color} </div>\r\n                                      {link.size && <span className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs flex-shrink-0\">{link.size}</span>}\r\n                                    </a>\r\n                                  ))}\r\n                                </div>\r\n                              )}\r\n                            </div>\r\n                          )\r\n                        })}\r\n                      </div>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )}\r\n\r\n                </div>\r\n              )\r\n            })()}\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Player Perspectives */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{DownloadsFormatter(downloads)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Downloads</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{views.toLocaleString()}</div>\r\n              <div */}\r\n      {\r\n        game.note && (\r\n          <div className=\"bg-yellow-500/10 rounded-2xl\">\r\n            <div className=\"p-4\">\r\n              <h3 className=\"text-yellow-400 font-bold text-sm\">{game.note}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Related Games */}\r\n      {\r\n        allGames.length > 0 && (() => {\r\n          const gameCategory = game.category\r\n\r\n          // Score each game by genre + feature overlap\r\n          const scored = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .map(g => {\r\n              const gGenres = g.genres || []\r\n              const gFeatures = (g.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || g.features || [])\r\n                .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n              const genreScore = gGenres.filter((genre: string) => gameGenres.includes(genre)).length * 2\r\n              const featureScore = gFeatures.filter((f: string) =>\r\n                gameFeatures.some(mf => mf.includes(f) || f.includes(mf))\r\n              ).length\r\n              return { ...g, score: genreScore + featureScore }\r\n            })\r\n            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)\r\n\r\n          const related = scored.slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          // Top in same category by rating\r\n          const topInCategory = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .sort((a, b) => (Number(b.rating) || 0) - (Number(a.rating) || 0))\r\n            .slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          if (related.length === 0 && topInCategory.length === 0) return null\r\n\r\n          const GameCard = ({ g, index }: { g: any; index?: number }) => (\r\n            <Link key={g.id} href={`/game/${g.id}`} className=\"group flex-shrink-0 w-28 sm:w-32\">\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#1a103c]\">\r\n                <img\r\n                  src={g.image || \"/placeholder.svg\"}\r\n                  alt={g.title}\r\n                  className=\"w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300      </div>\r\n                )}\r\n                <div className={`absolute ${index !== undefined && index < 3 ? from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\" />\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\">\r\n                  <p className=\"text-white text-[10px] font-medium line-clamp-2\">{g.title}</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1.5 line-clamp-1 group-hover:text-[#9d4edd] transition-colors\">{g.title}</p>\r\n            </Link>\r\n          )\r\n\r\n          return (\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\r\n              {related.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex      )}\r\n\r\n              {topInCategory.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Top {gameCategory === \"Android Games\" ? \"Android\" : \"PC\"} Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {topInCategory.map((g, i) => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} index={i} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          )\r\n        })()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Ratings & Reviews Section - Always visible */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2\">\r\n            <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n              Ratings & Reviews\r\n              <span className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm font-normal\">({reviews.length})</span>\r\n            </h3>\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <span className=\"px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium bg-yellow-500/20 border border-yellow-500/50 text-yellow-400\">\r\n                  Pending Approval\r\n                </span>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={withdrawReview}\r\n    </button>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={updateReview}\r\n                  className=\"px-3         )}\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${\r\n                  userReview && userReview.status !== 'pending'\r\n                    ? 'bg-green-500/20 border border-green-500/50 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/30' \r\n                    : 'bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white'\r\n                }`}\r\n              >\r\n                {userReview ? `Rated: ${userReview.rating} ★` : 'Write a Review'}\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n        \r\n        {reviews.length > 0 ? (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 space-y-4\">\r\n            {/* Average */}\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-xl\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n                <p className=\"text-4xl font-black text-white\">{(reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1)}</p>\r\n                <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-1 justify-center\">\r\n                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-4 h-4 ${s <= Math.round(reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length) ? 's' : ''}</p>\r\n                {userReview && (\r\n                  <div className=\"mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10\">\r\n                    <p className=\"text-green-400 text-xs font-medium\">Your Rating: {userReview.rating} ★</p>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n              <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-1\">\r\n                {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(star => {\r\n                  const count = reviews.filter(r => r.rating === star).length\r\n                  const pct = reviews.length ? Math.round((count / reviews.length) * 100) : 0\r\n                  return (\r\n                    <div key={star} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-xs\">\r\n                      <span rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden\">\r\n                        <div className=\"h-full bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-500 w-6 text-right\">{count}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )\r\n                })}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            {/* Individual reviews */}\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-3\">\r\n                {reviews.map(r => (\r\n                  <div key={r.id} className=\"bg-[#1a103c] border                  <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#9d4edd]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold\">{r.user_name?.charAt(0)}</div>\r\n                        <div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\r\n                            <p className=\"text-white text-sm font-semibold\">{r.user_name}</p>\r\n                            {r.user_badge && (\r\n                              <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${r.user_badge_color || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400 border-gray-500/30'}`}>\r\n                                {r.user_badge}\r\n                              </span>\r\n                            )}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-0.5\">\r\n                            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-3 h-3 ${s <= r.rating ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs\">{new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {r.content && <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm leading-relaxed\">{r.content}</p>}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        ) : (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 text-center\">\r\n            <div className=\"py-8\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-lg font-medium mb-2\">No reviews yet</p>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mb-4\">Be the first to share your experience!</p>\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className=\"px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white transition-colors\"\r\n              >\r\n                Write a Review\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )}\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Comments */}\r\n      <Comments gameId={game.id} itemName={game.title} />\r\n\r\n      {/* Review Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReviewModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => Review</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Star className=\"w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">Sign in to write a review</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reviewDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-6\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-bold text-lg\">Review submitted!</p>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1\">It will appear after admin approval.</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-5\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-3 text-center\">How would you rate this game?</p>\r\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-center gap-2\">\r\n                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                        <button key={s} type=\"button\"\r\n                          onMouseEnter={() => setReviewHover(s)} onMouseLeave={() => setReviewHover(0)}\r\n                          onClick={() => setReviewRating(s)}\r\n                          className=\"transition-transform hover:scale-125\">\r\n                          <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${s <= (reviewHover || reviewRating) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />\r\n                        </button>\r\n                      ))}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {reviewRating > 0 && (\r\n                      <p className=\"text-center text-sm mt-2 font-semibold\" style={{ color: ['', '#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'][reviewRating] }}>\r\n                        {['', 'Terrible', 'Poor', 'Average', 'Good', 'Excellent'][reviewRating]}\r\n                      </p>\r\n                    )}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1.5 block\">Share your experience <span className=\"text-gray-600\">(optional)</span></label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reviewContent} onChange={e => setReviewContent(e.target.value)} rows={4}\r\n                      placeholder=\"What did you think about this game?           "text": "Done! Here's what I implemented:\n\n### 1.
