            {
              "file": "README.md",
              "before": "# BullzGamez Website Clone\n\nA complete gaming and software download website built with Next.js, featuring a dark theme with red accents.\n\n## Features\n\n### Core Functionality\n- **Homepage**: Displays 12 items by default (15 for Android games layout)\n- **Category Filtering**: PC Games, Android Games, Software with intelligent tab switching\n- **Search System**: Intelligent search with category filters\n- **Individual Game Pages**: Detailed information with category-specific requirements\n- **Admin Portal**: Full CRUD operations with login authentication\n- **Comments System**: User comments on individual game pages\n- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with optimized layouts\n\n### Admin Portal Features\n- **Login System**: Secure admin authentication with changeable credentials\n- **Flexible Forms**: Category-specific fields (system requirements for PC/Software, Android requirements for mobile games, key features for software only)\n- **Item Management**: Add, edit, delete items with search functionality\n- **Trending Control**: Checkbox to control what appears in trending section\n- **Upload Date Tracking**: Automatic date tracking for new items\n\n### Design Features\n- **Custom Bull Logo**: Dangerous black bull with red horns\n- **Loading Animation**: Running black bull video for page transitions\n- **Dark Theme**: Gray/black background with red accent colors\n- **Responsive Grid**: Adaptive layouts for different screen sizes\n- **Visual Feedback**: Hover effects, transitions, and loading states\n\n## File Structure\n\n### Core Components\n- `components/header.tsx` - Navigation header with logo and search\n- `components/sidebar.tsx` - Trending games and quick links\n- `components/game-grid.tsx` - Main grid display with pagination\n- `components/game-details.tsx` - Individual game page layout\n- `components/loading-screen.tsx` - Full-screen loading animation\n- `components/loading-spinner.tsx` - Component-level loading indicator\n\n### Admin Components\n- `components/admin-login.tsx` - Authentication form\n- `components/admin-dashboard.tsx` - Main admin interface\n- `components/admin-item-form.tsx` - Add/edit item form with category-specific fields\n- `components/admin-item-list.tsx` - Manage existing items with search\n- `components/admin-settings.tsx` - Change admin credentials\n\n### Pages\n- `app/page.tsx` - Homepage with game grid\n- `app/categories/page.tsx` - Category overview with counts\n- `app/latest/page.tsx` - Latest releases\n- `app/contact/page.tsx` - Contact form\n- `app/search/page.tsx` - Search results with filters\n- `app/game/[id]/page.tsx` - Individual game pages\n- `app/admin/portal/page.tsx` - Admin portal entry\n\n### Search & Filter Components\n- `components/search-results.tsx` - Search results with category filters\n- `components/comments.tsx` - User comments system\n\n## How to Upload Items\n\n1. **Access Admin Portal**: Navigate to `/admin/portal`\n2. **Login**: Use admin credentials (default: admin/admin123)\n3. **Add New Item**: Click \"Add New Item\" button\n4. **Fill Form**: Complete category-specific fields:\n   - **All Categories**: Title, category, developer, description, rating, image URL\n   - **PC Games/Software**: System requirements (minimum/recommended)\n   - **Android Games**: Android requirements (OS version, RAM, storage, processor)\n   - **Software Only**: Key features list\n5. **Set Trending**: Check \"Show in Trending\" to display in sidebar\n6. **Add Downloads**: Provide download links with names and sizes\n7. **Save**: Click \"Save Item\" to add to website\n\n## Category-Specific Fields\n\n### PC Games\n- System Requirements (OS, Processor, Memory, Graphics, Storage)\n- No key features section\n- Full system specifications for minimum and recommended\n\n### Android Games\n- Android Requirements (OS version, RAM, Storage, Processor)\n- No system requirements or key features\n- Optimized for mobile specifications\n\n### Software\n- System Requirements (same as PC Games)\n- Key Features list (unique selling points)\n- Professional software specifications\n\n## Data Storage\n\nItems are stored in localStorage for demo purposes.   <TabsContent value=\"modifier\" className=\"mt-0 outline-none\">\n            <AdminPageModifier />\n          </TabsContent>\n\n          <TabsContent value=\"feedback\" className=\"mt-0 const [rejectReason, setRejectReason] = useState<Record<string, string>>({})\n  const [expandedUser, setExpandedUser] = useState<string | null>(null)\n\n  const load = async () => {\n    setLoading(true)\n    const res = await fetch('/api/admin/users')\n    const data = await res.json()\n    if (data.users) setUsers(data.users)\n    setLoading(false)\n  }\n\n  useEffect(() => { load() }, [])\n\n  const sendNotif = async () => {\n    if (!notifTitle || !notifMsg) return\n    setSending(true)\n    await fetch('/api/admin/users', {\n      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': setSending(false)\n    setNotifTitle(\"\"); setNotifMsg(\"\")\n    alert(\"Notification sent!\")\n  }\n\n  const deleteUser = async (id: string) => {\n    if (!confirm(\"Delete this user?\")) return\n    await fetch('/api/admin/users', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ action: 'delete_user', user_id: id }) })\n    load()\n  }\n\n  const  <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-yellow-500/30 rounded-xl overflow-hidden\">\n          <div className=\"p-4 border-b border-yellow-500/20 flex items-center gap-2\" style={{ background:       </div>\n          <div className=\"divide-y divide-[#2d1b54]/50\">\n            {pendingUsers.map(u => (\n              <div key={u.id} className=\"p-4\">\n                <div className=\"flex                 <div className=\"flex gap-2\">\n                      <Button size=\"sm\" onClick={() => approveSubscription(u.id)} className=\"flex-1 bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 text-xs\">✓               "after": "\"use client\"\r\n\r\nimport { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from \"react\"\r\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\"\r\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\"\r\nimport { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from \"@/components/ui/tabs\"\r\nimport { MessageSquare, Star, Trash2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Eye, Search, Reply } from \"lucide-react\"\r\nimport { Textarea } from \"@/components/ui/textarea\"\r\n\r\nexport function AdminFeedback() {\r\n  const [comments, setComments] = useState<any[]>([])\r\n  const [reviews, setReviews] = useState<any[]>([])\r\n  const [commentSearch, setCommentSearch] = useState(\"\")\r\n  const [reviewSearch, setReviewSearch] = useState(\"\")\r\n  const [replyTarget, setReplyTarget] = useState<any | null>(null)\r\n  const [replyText, setReplyText] = useState(\"\")\r\n  const [replySubmitting, setReplySubmitting] = useState(false)\r\n\r\n  const getAdminToken = () => {\r\n    try { return localStorage.getItem('admin_token') || '' } catch { return '' }\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const loadComments = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetch('/api/comments?BullzGamez-Admin=1', { cache: 'no-store' })\r\n      const json = await res.json()\r\n      if (json.success) setComments(json.data || [])\r\n    } catch {}\r\n  }\r\n  const loadReviews = async () => {\r\n    try {\r\n      const res = await fetch('/api/reviews?all=1', { cache: 'no-store' })\r\n      const json = await res.json()\r\n      if (json.reviews) setReviews(json.reviews)\r\n    } catch {}\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => { loadComments(); {\r\n    await fetch('/api/reviews', { method: 'PATCH', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ id, status }) })\r\n    loadReviews()\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const deleteReview = async (id: number) => {\r\n    if (!confirm('Delete this review?')) return\r\n    await fetch(`/api/reviews?id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' })\r\n    loadReviews()\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  const               "after": "\"use client\"\r\n\r\nimport type React from \"react\"\r\nimport { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from \"react\"\r\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\"\r\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\"\r\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\"\r\nimport { Textarea } from \"@/components/ui/textarea\"\r\nimport { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from \"@/components/ui/select\"\r\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from \"@/components/ui/card\"\r\nimport { GameDetails } from \"@/components/game-details\"\r\nimport { Plus, Trash2, Save, Copy, ExternalLink } from \"lucide-react\"\r\nimport Editor from \"@monaco-editor/react\"\r\n\r\nconst cleanScreenshotUrl = (url: string): string => {\r\n  if (!url) return url\r\n  if (url.includes('riotpixels.net')) {\r\n    const lastJpgIndex = url.lastIndexOf('.jpg')\r\n    const slashAfterJpg = url.indexOf('/', lastJpgIndex)\r\n    if (slashAfterJpg !== -1) url = url.substring(0, slashAfterJpg)\r\n    url = url.replace(/\\.240p\\.jpg$/, '.jpg').replace(/\\.480p\\.jpg$/, '.jpg').replace(/\\.1080p\\.jpg$/, '.jpg').replace(/\\.jpg\\.jpg$/, '.jpg').replace(/^http:/, 'https:')\r\n  }\r\n  url = url.replace(/_\\d+x\\d+\\./g, '.').replace(/-thumb\\./g, '.').replace(/-small\\./g, '.').replace(/-medium\\./g, '.')\r\n  return url\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface FormData {\r\n  title: string; category: string; description: string; longDescription: string\r\n  developer: string; publisher?: string; size: string; releaseDate: string; publishedDate?: string; image: string\r\n  landscapeImage?: string; trailerUrl?: string; steamUrl?: string; edition?: string\r\n  genres?: string[]\r\n  rating: string; latest: boolean; keyFeatures: string[]; screenshots: string[]; note?: string\r\n  systemRequirements: { recommended: { os: string; processor: string; memory: string; graphics: string; storage: string; directx: string; sound_card: string } }\r\n  androidRequirements: { recommended: { os: string; ram: string; storage: string; processor: string } }\r\n  sharedPinCode: string; sharedRarPassword?: string\r\n  cloudDownloads: Array<{ cloudName: string; actualProvider?: string; customProvider?: string; partsNumber?: number; version?: string; actualDownloadLinks: Array<{ name: string; url: string; size: string }> }>\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst initialFormData: FormData = {\r\n  title: \"\", category: \"\", description: \"\", longDescription: \"\", developer: \"\", publisher: \"\",\r\n  size: \"\", releaseDate: \"\", publishedDate: \"\", image: \"\", landscapeImage: \"\", trailerUrl: \"\", steamUrl: \"\", edition: \"\",\r\n  genres: [], rating: \"4.0\", latest: true, keyFeatures: [\"\"],\r\n  screenshots: [], note: \"\",\r\n  systemRequirements: { recommended: { os: \"\", processor: \"\", memory: \"\", graphics: \"\", storage: \"\", directx: \"\", sound_card: \"\" } },\r\n  androidRequirements: { recommended: { os: \"Android 12\", ram: \"8 GB\", storage: \"350 MB\", processor: \"Snapdragon / MediaTek (Average Processors)\" } },\r\n  sharedPinCode: \"1234\", sharedRarPassword: \"\",\r\n  cloudDownloads: [{ cloudName: \"\", partsNumber: undefined, version: undefined, actualDownloadLinks: [{ name: \"\", url: \"\", size: \"\" }] }],\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport function AdminItemForm({ editItem, onSave, overrideApiUrl, overrideApiHeaders, overrideMethod, overrideBody, onTitleChange }: {\r\n  editItem?: any\r\n  onSave?: () => void\r\n  overrideApiUrl?: string\r\n  overrideApiHeaders?: Record<string, string>\r\n  overrideMethod?: (isEdit: boolean) => string\r\n  overrideBody?: (isEdit: boolean, id: number | undefined, formData: any) => any\r\n  onTitleChange?: (title: string) => void\r\n}) {\r\n  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<FormData>(() => {\r\n    if (editItem) {\r\n      return {\r\n        ...editItem,\r\n        publisher: editItem.publisher || \"\",\r\n        publishedDate: editItem.publishedDate || editItem.releaseDate || \"\",\r\n        landscapeImage: editItem.landscapeImage || \"\",\r\n        trailerUrl: editItem.trailerUrl || \"\",\r\n        steamUrl: editItem.steamUrl || \"\",\r\n        edition: editItem.edition || \"\",\r\n        genres: editItem.genres || [],\r\n        screenshots: editItem.screenshots || [],\r\n        note: editItem.note || \"\",\r\n        sharedPinCode: editItem.sharedPinCode || \"1234\",\r\n        sharedRarPassword: editItem.sharedRarPassword || \"\",\r\n        cloudDownloads: editItem.cloudDownloads || [{ cloudName: \"\", partsNumber: undefined, version: undefined, actualDownloadLinks: [{ name: \"\", url: \"\", size: \"\" }] }],\r\n        systemRequirements: editItem.systemRequirements || { recommended: { os: \"\", processor: \"\", memory: \"\", graphics: \"\", storage: \"\", directx: \"\", sound_card: \"\" } },\r\n        androidRequirements: editItem.androidRequirements || { recommended: { os: \"Android 12\", ram: \"8 GB\", storage: \"350 MB\", processor: \"Snapdragon / MediaTek (Average Processors)\" } },\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n    return { ...initialFormData, sharedPinCode: String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)) }\r\n  })\r\n\r\n  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {\r\n    e.preventDefault()\r\n    try {\r\n      const isEdit = !!editItem\r\n      const url = overrideApiUrl || \"/api/items\"\r\n      const method = overrideMethod ? overrideMethod(isEdit) : (isEdit ? \"PUT\" : \"POST\")\r\n      const body = overrideBody\r\n        ? overrideBody(isEdit, editItem?.id, formData)\r\n        : (isEdit ? { id: editItem.id, ...formData } : formData)\r\n      const response = await fetch(url, {\r\n        method,\r\n        headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\", ...(overrideApiHeaders || {}) },\r\n        body: JSON.stringify(body)\r\n      })\r\n      const result = await response.json()\r\n      if (response.ok && result.success) {\r\n        alert(isEdit ? \"Item updated successfully!\" : \"Item saved successfully!\")\r\n        if (onSave) ${style.color}`}>{cloud.cloudName || 'Cloud'}</p>\r\n                                    {links.length > 0 && <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs\">{links.length} link{links.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>}\r\n                                  </div>\r\n                                </div>\r\n                                {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className=\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-400\" /> : <ChevronDown className=\"w-4 h-4 text-gray-400\" />}\r\n                              </button>\r\n                              {isExpanded && links.length > 0 && (\r\n                                <div className=\"border-t border-white/10 p-2 space-y-1.5\">\r\n                                  {links.map((link, li) => (\r\n                                    <a\r\n                                      key={li}\r\n                                      href={link.url}\r\n                                      target=\"_blank\"\r\n                                      rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\r\n                                      className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-black/20 rounded-lg hover:bg-black/40 transition-all\"\r\n                                    >\r\n                                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0\">\r\n                                        <Download className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${style.color} flex-shrink-0`} />\r\n                                        <span className=\"text-white text-sm truncate\">{link.name || `Download ${li + 1}`}</span>\r\n                                      </div>\r\n                                      {link.size && <span className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs flex-shrink-0\">{link.size}</span>}\r\n                                    </a>\r\n                                  ))}\r\n                                </div>\r\n                              )}\r\n                            </div>\r\n                          )\r\n                        })}\r\n                      </div>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )}\r\n\r\n                </div>\r\n              )\r\n            })()}\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Player Perspectives */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold text-lg\">Player Perspectives</h3>\r\n        </div>\r\n        <div className=\"p-6\">\r\n          <div className=\"grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4\">\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{averageRating.toFixed(1)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Average Score</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-green-400 mb-1\">{recommendPercent}%</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Recommend</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{DownloadsFormatter(downloads)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Downloads</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{views.toLocaleString()}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Views</div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n          <div className=\"flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 mt-4 relative\">\r\n            <div className=\"relative\">\r\n              <Button\r\n                variant=\"outline\"\r\n                className={`border-white/20 transition-colors ${userReaction === 'like' ? 'text-green-400 border-green-500/50 bg-green-500/10' : 'text-foreground hover:bg-white/10'}`}\r\n                onClick={() => handleReaction('like')}\r\n              >\r\n                <ThumbsUp className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${userReaction === 'like' ? 'fill-green-400' : ''}`} />\r\n                Like {likes > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-xs\">{likes}</span>}\r\n              </Button>\r\n              {showReactionLoginPrompt && (\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-2 px-3 py-2 bg-[#120b22] border border-[#9d4edd]/40 rounded-lg text-xs text-white whitespace-nowrap shadow-xl z-50\">\r\n                  <a href=\"/login\" className=\"text-[#9d4edd] font-semibold hover:underline\">Login</a> or <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"text-[#9d4edd] font-semibold hover:underline\">Sign up</a> to react\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n            <Button\r\n              variant=\"outline\"\r\n              className={`border-white/20 transition-colors ${userReaction === 'dislike' ? 'text-red-400 border-red-500/50 bg-red-500/10' : 'text-foreground hover:bg-white/10'}`}\r\n              onClick={() => handleReaction('dislike')}\r\n            >\r\n              <ThumbsDown className={`w-4 h-4 mr-2 ${userReaction === 'dislike' ? 'fill-red-400' : ''}`} />\r\n              Dislike {dislikes > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-xs\">{dislikes}</span>}\r\n            </Button>\r\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" className=\"border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10\" onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}>\r\n              <MessageCircle className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              Write Review\r\n            </Button>\r\n            <Button variant=\"outline\" className=\"border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 hover:border-red-500/30\" onClick={() => setShowReportModal(true)}>\r\n              <Flag className=\"w-4 h-4 mr-2\" />\r\n              Report\r\n            </Button>\r\n          </div>        </div>\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Note */}\r\n      {\r\n        game.note && (\r\n          <div className=\"bg-yellow-500/10 rounded-2xl\">\r\n            <div className=\"p-4\">\r\n              <h3 className=\"text-yellow-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-2 mb-2\">\r\n                <AlertTriangle className=\"w-4 h-4\" />\r\n                Note\r\n              </h3>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">{game.note}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Related Games */}\r\n      {\r\n        allGames.length > 0 && (() => {\r\n          const gameGenres = game.genres || []\r\n          const gameFeatures = (game.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || game.features || [])\r\n            .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n          const gameCategory = game.category\r\n\r\n          // Score each game by genre + feature overlap\r\n          const scored = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .map(g => {\r\n              const gGenres = g.genres || []\r\n              const gFeatures = (g.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || g.features || [])\r\n                .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n              const genreScore = gGenres.filter((genre: string) => gameGenres.includes(genre)).length * 2\r\n              const featureScore = gFeatures.filter((f: string) =>\r\n                gameFeatures.some(mf => mf.includes(f) || f.includes(mf))\r\n              ).length\r\n              return { ...g, score: genreScore + featureScore }\r\n            })\r\n            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)\r\n\r\n          const related = scored.slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          // Top in same category by rating\r\n          const topInCategory = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .sort((a, b) => (Number(b.rating) || 0) - (Number(a.rating) || 0))\r\n            .slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          if (related.length === 0 && topInCategory.length === 0) return null\r\n\r\n          const GameCard = ({ g, index }: { g: any; index?: number }) => (\r\n            <Link key={g.id} href={`/game/${g.id}`} className=\"group flex-shrink-0 w-28 sm:w-32\">\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#1a103c]\">\r\n                <img\r\n                  src={g.image || \"/placeholder.svg\"}\r\n                  alt={g.title}\r\n                  className=\"w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-110\"\r\n                />\r\n                {index !== undefined && index < 3 && (\r\n                  <div className={`absolute top-1.5 left-1.5 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-white ${index === 0 ? \"bg-yellow-500\" : index === 1 ? \"bg-gray-400\" : \"bg-amber-700\"}`}>\r\n                    {index + 1}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n                <div className={`absolute ${index !== undefined && index < 3 ? 'top-1.5 right-1.5' : 'top-1.5 left-1.5'} px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-white text-[8px] font-bold uppercase shadow-lg z-10 ${g.category === \"Android Games\" ? \"bg-green-500/90\" : \"bg-blue-500/90\"}`}>\r\n                  {g.category === \"Android Games\" ? \"APK\" : \"PC\"}\r\n                </div>\r\n                <div className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\" />\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\">\r\n                  <p className=\"text-white text-[10px] font-medium line-clamp-2\">{g.title}</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1.5 line-clamp-1 group-hover:text-[#9d4edd] transition-colors\">{g.title}</p>\r\n            </Link>\r\n          )\r\n\r\n          return (\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\r\n              {related.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-[#9d4edd] rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Related Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {related.map(g => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n\r\n              {topInCategory.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Top {gameCategory === \"Android Games\" ? \"Android\" : \"PC\"} Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {topInCategory.map((g, i) => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} index={i} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          )\r\n        })()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Approved Reviews */}\r\n      {\r\n        reviews.length > 0 && (\r\n          <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n            <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n              <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                <Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n                Ratings & Reviews\r\n                <span className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm font-normal\">({reviews.length})</span>\r\n              </h3>\r\n            </div>\r\n            <div className=\"p-6 space-y-4\">\r\n              {/* Average */}\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-xl\">\r\n                <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n                  <p className=\"text-4xl font-black text-white\">{(reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1)}</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-1 justify-center\">\r\n                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-4 h-4 ${s <= Math.round(reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-xs mt-1\">{reviews.length} review{reviews.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n                <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-1\">\r\n                  {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(star => {\r\n                    const count = reviews.filter(r => r.rating === star).length\r\n                    const pct = reviews.length ? Math.round((count / reviews.length) * 100) : 0\r\n                    return (\r\n                      <div key={star} className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-xs\">\r\n                        <span className=\"text-gray-400 w-3\">{star}</span>\r\n                        <Star className=\"w-3 h-3 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500\" />\r\n                        <div className=\"flex-1 bg-[#1a103c] rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden\">\r\n                          <div className=\"h-full bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />\r\n                        </div>\r\n                        <span className=\"text-gray-500 w-6 text-right\">{count}</span>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                    )\r\n                  })}\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {/* Individual reviews */}\r\n              <div className=\"space-y-3\">\r\n                {reviews.map(r => (\r\n                  <div key={r.id} className=\"bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-xl p-4\">\r\n                    <div className=\"flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2\">\r\n                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                        <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#9d4edd]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold\">{r.user_name?.charAt(0)}</div>\r\n                        <div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\r\n                            <p className=\"text-white text-sm font-semibold\">{r.user_name}</p>\r\n                            {r.user_badge && (\r\n                              <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${r.user_badge_color || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400 border-gray-500/30'}`}>\r\n                                {r.user_badge}\r\n                              </span>\r\n                            )}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-0.5\">\r\n                            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-3 h-3 ${s <= r.rating ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs\">{new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {r.content && <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm leading-relaxed\">{r.content}</p>}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Comments */}\r\n      <Comments gameId={game.id} itemName={game.title} />\r\n\r\n      {/* Review Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReviewModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-5\">\r\n                <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold text-lg flex items-center gap-2\"><Star className=\"w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500\" /> Rate & Review</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Star className=\"w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">Sign in to write a review</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reviewDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-6\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-bold text-lg\">Review submitted!</p>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1\">It will appear after admin approval.</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-5\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-3 text-center\">How would you rate this game?</p>\r\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-center gap-2\">\r\n                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                        <button key={s} type=\"button\"\r\n                          onMouseEnter={() => setReviewHover(s)} onMouseLeave={() => setReviewHover(0)}\r\n                          onClick={() => setReviewRating(s)}\r\n                          className=\"transition-transform hover:scale-125\">\r\n                          <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${s <= (reviewHover || reviewRating) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />\r\n                        </button>\r\n                      ))}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {reviewRating > 0 && (\r\n                      <p className=\"text-center text-sm mt-2 font-semibold\" style={{ color: ['', '#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'][reviewRating] }}>\r\n                        {['', 'Terrible', 'Poor', 'Average', 'Good', 'Excellent'][reviewRating]}\r\n                      </p>\r\n                    )}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1.5 block\">Share your experience <span className=\"text-gray-600\">(optional)</span></label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reviewContent} onChange={e => setReviewContent(e.target.value)} rows={4}\r\n                      placeholder=\"What did you think about this game? Any tips for other players?\"\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] focus:border-[#9d4edd] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none transition-colors text-sm resize-none\" />\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <button onClick={submitReview} disabled={reviewSubmitting || !reviewRating}\r\n                    className=\"w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-white transition-all disabled:opacity-40 hover:scale-[1.01]\"\r\n                    style={{ background: \"linear-gradient(135deg, #9d4edd, #7b2cbf)\" }}>\r\n                    {reviewSubmitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit Review'}\r\n                  </button>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs text-center\">Reviews are shown after admin approval</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Trailer Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        trailerOpen && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/95 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setTrailerOpen(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"relative w-full max-w-4xl\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <button onClick={() => setTrailerOpen(false)} className=\"absolute -top-10 right-0 text-white/80 hover:text-white text-2xl font-bold z-10 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                <X className=\"w-6 h-6\" /> Close\r\n              </button>\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-video rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black shadow-2xl\">\r\n                {trailerYtId ? (\r\n                  <iframe\r\n                    src={`https://www.youtube.com/embed/${trailerYtId}?autoplay=1`}\r\n                    className=\"w-full h-full\"\r\n                    allow=\"autoplay; fullscreen\"\r\n                    allowFullScreen\r\n                  />\r\n                ) : (\r\n                  <video src={game.trailerUrl} controls autoPlay className=\"w-full h-full\" />\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Report Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReportModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() => setShowReportModal(false)}>\r\n            <div className=\"bg-[#120b22] border border-[#2d1b54] rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md\" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>\r\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-4\">\r\n                <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold flex items-center gap-2\"><Flag className=\"w-4 h-4 text-red-400\" /> Report Issue</h3>\r\n                <button onClick={() => setShowReportModal(false)} className=\"text-gray-500 hover:text-white\"><X className=\"w-5 h-5\" /></button>\r\n              </div>\r\n              {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Flag className=\"w-10 h-10 text-red-400 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">You need to be logged in to report an issue.</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reportDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-10 h-10 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-2\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-semibold\">Report submitted!</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-4\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1 block\">Report Type</label>\r\n                    <select value={reportType} onChange={e => setReportType(e.target.value)}\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#9d4edd]\">\r\n                      <option value=\"error\">Download Error</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"broken_link\">Broken Link</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"wrong_game\">Wrong Game</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"virus\">Virus/Malware</option>\r\n                      <option value=\"other\">Other</option>\r\n                    </select>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1 block\">Description *</label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reportDesc} onChange={e => setReportDesc(e.target.value)} rows={3}\r\n                      placeholder=\"Describe the issue...\"\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] focus:border-[#9d4edd] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-white placeholder-gray-500 outline-none transition-colors text-sm resize-none\" />\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <button onClick={submitReport} disabled={reportSubmitting || !reportDesc.trim()}\r\n                    className=\"w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white transition-all disabled:opacity-60\"\r\n                    style={{ background: \"linear-gradient(135deg, #9d4edd, #7b2cbf)\" }}>\r\n                    {reportSubmitting ?               "before": "import { supabase } from '../supabase'\n\nexport interface AdminCredentials {\n  username: string\n  password: string\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS: AdminCredentials = {\n  username: \"admin\",\n  password: \"bullzgamez2024\"\n}\n\nexport async function getAdminCredentials(): Promise<AdminCredentials> {\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('admin_credentials')\n      .select('username, password')\n      .single()\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('Error fetching admin credentials:', error)\n      // Return default credentials if none exist in database\n      return DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS\n    }\n\n    return {\n      username: data.username,\n      password: data.password\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error in getAdminCredentials:', error)\n    return DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function updateAdminCredentials(credentials: AdminCredentials): Promise<void> {\n  const { error } = await supabase\n    .from('admin_credentials')\n    .update({\n      username: credentials.username,\n      password: credentials.password,\n      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()\n    })\n    .eq('username', credentials.username)\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error('Error updating admin credentials:', error)\n    throw error\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function validateCredentials(username: string, password: string): Promise<boolean> {\n  const stored = await getAdminCredentials()\n  return username === stored.username && password === stored.password\n}",
              "after": "import { supabase } from '../supabase'\r\n\r\nexport interface AdminCredentials {\r\n  username: string\r\n  password: string\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS: AdminCredentials = {\r\n  username: \"admin\",\r\n  password: \"bullzgamez2024\"\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function getAdminCredentials(): Promise<AdminCredentials> {\r\n  try {\r\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\r\n      .from('admin_credentials')\r\n      .select('username, password')\r\n      .single()\r\n\r\n    if (error) {\r\n      console.error('Error fetching admin credentials:', error)\r\n      // Return default credentials if none exist in database\r\n      return DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    return {\r\n      username: data.username,\r\n      password: data.password\r\n    }\r\n  } catch (error) {\r\n    console.error('Error in getAdminCredentials:', error)\r\n    return DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function updateAdminCredentials(credentials: AdminCredentials): Promise<void> {\r\n  const { error } = await supabase\r\n    .from('admin_credentials')\r\n    .update({\r\n      username: credentials.username,\r\n      password: credentials.password,\r\n      updated_at: new Date().toISOString()\r\n    })\r\n    .eq('username', credentials.username)\r\n\r\n  if (error) {\r\n    console.error('Error updating admin credentials:', error)\r\n    throw error\r\n  }\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function validateCredentials(username: string, password: string): Promise<boolean> {\r\n  const stored = await getAdminCredentials()\r\n  return username === stored.username && password === stored.password\r\n}",

async function checkSystemStatus(): Promise<SystemStatus> {\n  const status: SystemStatus = {\n    supabase: { connected: false },\n    database: { tablesExist: false, itemCount: 0, commentCount: 0, status.supabase.connected = true\n      status.supabase.projectUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL\n    } else {\n      status.supabase.error = error.message\n    }\n\n    // Check database tables and counts\n    if (status.supabase.connected) {\n      try {\n        // Check items count\n        const { count: itemCount, error: itemError } = await supabase\n          .from('items')\n          .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        if (!itemError) {\n          status.database.itemCount = itemCount || 0\n          status.database.tablesExist = true\n        }\n\n        // Check comments count\n        const { count: commentCount, error: commentError } = await supabase\n          .from('comments')\n          .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        if (!commentError) {\n          status.database.commentCount = commentCount || 0\n        }\n\n        // Check download pages count\n        const { count: downloadCount, error: downloadError } = await supabase\n          .from('download_pages')\n          .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        if (!downloadError) {\n          status.database.downloadPageCount = downloadCount || 0\n        }\n      } catch (dbError: any) {\n        status.database.tablesExist = false\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Vercel info (from environment)\n    status.vercel.deploymentUrl = process.env.VERCEL_URL ? size: string; sizeBytes: number }>\n  storagePercent: number\n  tier: string\n  quotas: Array<{\n    name: string\n    limit: string\n    used: string | null\n    percent: number | null\n    description: string\n  }>\n}> {\n  const STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES = 1 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 // 1 GB free tier\n\n  let totalStorageBytes = 0\n  const bucketStats: Array<{ name: string; size: string; sizeBytes: number }> = []\n\n  try {\n    const { data: buckets, error: bucketsError } = await supabase.storage.listBuckets()\n    if (!bucketsError && buckets && buckets.length > 0) {\n      for (const bucket of buckets) {\n        const sizeBytes = await getBucketSize(bucket.name)\n        totalStorageBytes += sizeBytes\n        bucketStats.push({ name: bucket.name, size: formatBytes(sizeBytes), sizeBytes })\n      }\n    }\n  } catch {}\n\n  const storagePercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((totalStorageBytes / STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES) * 1000) / 10)\n  const storageUsed = formatBytes(totalStorageBytes)\n\n  // Count users for Auth MAU estimate\n  let userCount = 0\n  try {\n    const { count } = await supabase.from('users').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n    userCount = count || 0\n  } catch {}\n\n  const authPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((userCount / 50000) * 1000) / 10)\n\n  // Get real database size via pg_database_size()\n  let dbSizeStr = 'run add_get_db_size_fn.sql first'\n  let dbPercent: number | null = null\n  try {\n    const { data: dbSize } = await supabase.rpc('get_db_size')\n    if (dbSize) {\n      const dbSizeBytes = Number(dbSize)\n      dbSizeStr = formatBytes(dbSizeBytes)\n      dbPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((dbSizeBytes / (500 * 1024 * 1024)) * 1000) / 10)\n    }\n  } catch {}\n\n  // Supabase free tier does NOT expose bandwidth/edge/realtime via any public API.\n  // These metrics are only visible inside the Supabase dashboard (internal systems).\n  const projectRef = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL?.match(/https:\\/\\/([^.]+)\\./)?.[1] ?? ''\n  const dashboardUrl = `https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/${projectRef}/reports`\n\n  const quotas = [\n    {\n      name: 'Database',\n      limit: '500 MB',\n      used: dbSizeStr,\n      percent: dbPercent,\n      description: 'Full Postgres database storage for your tables and data.',\n      dashboardUrl: null,\n    },\n    {\n      name: 'File Storage',\n      limit: '1 GB',\n      used: storageUsed,\n      percent: storagePercent,\n      description: 'Dedicated space for images, videos, and documents.',\n      dashboardUrl: null,\n    },\n    {\n      name: 'Auth (Users)',\n      limit: '50,000 MAU',\n      used: `${userCount.toLocaleString()} registered`,\n      percent: authPercent,\n      description: 'Monthly Active Users who log in or refresh tokens.',\n      dashboardUrl: null,\n    },\n    {\n      name: 'Bandwidth',\n      limit: '5 GB egress',\n      used: null,\n      percent: null,\n      description: 'Total data transfer out of your project per month.',\n      dashboardUrl,\n    },\n    {\n      name: 'Edge Functions',\n      limit: '500,000 invocations',\n      used: null,\n      percent: null,\n      description: 'Total serverless function invocations per month.',\n      dashboardUrl,\n    },\n    {\n      name: 'Realtime',\n      limit: '2 million messages',\n      used: null,\n      percent: null,\n      description: 'Total messages sent via WebSockets per month.',\n      dashboardUrl,\n    },\n  ]\n\n  return { storageUsed, storageBuckets: bucketStats, storagePercent, tier: 'Free', quotas }\n}",

'Recent' : 'Unknown'\r\n\r\n  } catch (error: any) {\r\n    status.supabase.error = error.message\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return status\r\n}\r\n\r\nfunction formatBytes(bytes: number): string {\r\n  if (bytes === 0) return '0 B'\r\n  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`\r\n  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`\r\n  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB`\r\n  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} GB`\r\n}\r\n\r\nasync function getBucketSize(bucketName: string): Promise<number> {\r\n  let totalBytes = 0\r\n  const listFolder = async (prefix: string) => {\r\n    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage.from(bucketName).list(prefix, { limit: 1000 })\r\n    if (error || !data) return\r\n    for (const item of data) {\r\n      if (item.metadata?.size) {\r\n        totalBytes += item.metadata.size\r\n      } else if (!item.id) {\r\n        // It's a folder — recurse\r\n        await listFolder(prefix ? `${prefix}/${item.name}` : item.name)\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  }\r\n  await listFolder('')\r\n  return totalBytes\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport async function getSupabaseUsage(): Promise<{\r\n  storageUsed: string\r\n  storageBuckets: Array<{ name: string; size: string; sizeBytes: number }>\r\n  storagePercent: number\r\n  tier: string\r\n  quotas: Array<{\r\n    name: string\r\n    limit: string\r\n    used: string | null\r\n    percent: number | null\r\n    description: string\r\n  }>\r\n}> {\r\n  const STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES = 1 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 // 1 GB free tier\r\n\r\n  let totalStorageBytes = 0\r\n  const bucketStats: Array<{ name: string; size: string; sizeBytes: number }> = []\r\n\r\n  try {\r\n    const { data: buckets, error: bucketsError } = await supabase.storage.listBuckets()\r\n    if (!bucketsError && buckets && buckets.length > 0) {\r\n      for (const bucket of buckets) {\r\n        const sizeBytes = await getBucketSize(bucket.name)\r\n        totalStorageBytes += sizeBytes\r\n        bucketStats.push({ name: bucket.name, size: formatBytes(sizeBytes), sizeBytes })\r\n      }\r\n    }\r\n  } catch {}\r\n\r\n  const storagePercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((totalStorageBytes / STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES) * 1000) / 10)\r\n  const storageUsed = formatBytes(totalStorageBytes)\r\n\r\n  // Count users for Auth MAU estimate\r\n  let userCount = 0\r\n  try {\r\n    const { count } = await supabase.from('users').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\r\n    userCount = count || 0\r\n  } catch {}\r\n\r\n  const authPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((userCount / 50000) * 1000) / 10)\r\n\r\n  // Get real database size via pg_database_size()\r\n  let dbSizeStr = 'run add_get_db_size_fn.sql first'\r\n  let dbPercent: number | null = null\r\n  try {\r\n    const { data: dbSize } = await supabase.rpc('get_db_size')\r\n    if (dbSize) {\r\n      const dbSizeBytes = Number(dbSize)\r\n      dbSizeStr = formatBytes(dbSizeBytes)\r\n      dbPercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((dbSizeBytes / (500 * 1024 * 1024)) * 1000) / 10)\r\n    }\r\n  } catch {}\r\n\r\n  // Supabase free tier does NOT expose bandwidth/edge/realtime via any public API.\r\n  // These metrics are only visible inside the Supabase dashboard (internal systems).\r\n  const projectRef = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL?.match(/https:\\/\\/([^.]+)\\./)?.[1] ?? ''\r\n  const dashboardUrl = `https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/${projectRef}/reports`\r\n\r\n  const quotas = [\r\n    {\r\n      name: 'Database',\r\n      limit: '500 MB',\r\n      used: dbSizeStr,\r\n      percent: dbPercent,\r\n      description: 'Full Postgres database storage for your tables and data.',\r\n      dashboardUrl: null,\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      name: 'File Storage',\r\n      limit: '1 GB',\r\n      used: storageUsed,\r\n      percent: storagePercent,\r\n      description: 'Dedicated space for images, videos, and documents.',\r\n      dashboardUrl: null,\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      name: 'Auth (Users)',\r\n      limit: '50,000 MAU',\r\n      used: `${userCount.toLocaleString()} registered`,\r\n      percent: authPercent,\r\n      description: 'Monthly Active Users who log in or refresh tokens.',\r\n      dashboardUrl: null,\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      name: 'Bandwidth',\r\n      limit: '5 GB egress',\r\n      used: null,\r\n      percent: null,\r\n      description: 'Total data transfer out of your project per month.',\r\n      dashboardUrl,\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      name: 'Edge Functions',\r\n      limit: '500,000 invocations',\r\n      used: null,\r\n      percent: null,\r\n      description: 'Total serverless function invocations per month.',\r\n      dashboardUrl,\r\n    },\r\n    {\r\n      name: 'Realtime',\r\n      limit: '2 million messages',\r\n      used: null,\r\n      percent: null,\r\n      description: 'Total messages sent via WebSockets per month.',\r\n      dashboardUrl,\r\n    },\r\n  ]\r\n\r\n  return { storageUsed, storageBuckets: bucketStats, storagePercent, tier: 'Free', quotas }\r\n}",

) : (\r\n                    /* Android - single download section */\r\n                    <div className=\"bg-gradient-to-br from-[#9d4edd]/10 to-[#9d4edd]/5 border border-[#9d4edd]/30 rounded-2xl <div>\r\n                          <h3 className=\"text-white font-bold text-lg\">APK Download</h3>\r\n                          <p className=\"text-[#9d4edd] text-xs\">Modded Android Game</p>\r\n                        </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <div className=\"p-4 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3\">\r\n                        {allLinks.map((cloud, ci) => {\r\n                          const style = getCloudStyle(cloud.cloudName)\r\n                          const isExpanded = expandedCloud === ci\r\n                          const links =                        <button\r\n                                className=\"w-full flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3\"\r\n                                onClick={() =>   <div className=\"border-t border-white/10 p-2 space-y-1.5\">\r\n                                  {links.map((link, li) => (\r\n                                    <a\r\n                                      key={li}\r\n                                      href={link.url}\r\n                                      target=\"_blank\"\r\n                                      rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\r\n                                      className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-black/20 rounded-lg hover:bg-black/40 transition-all\"\r\n                                    >\r\n                                      <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0\">\r\n                                        <Download className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${style.color} </div>\r\n                                      {link.size && <span className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs flex-shrink-0\">{link.size}</span>}\r\n                                    </a>\r\n                                  ))}\r\n                                </div>\r\n                              )}\r\n                            </div>\r\n                          )\r\n                        })}\r\n                      </div>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )}\r\n\r\n                </div>\r\n              )\r\n            })()}\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Player Perspectives */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold <div className=\"text-3xl font-bold text-foreground mb-1\">{DownloadsFormatter(downloads)}</div>\r\n              <div className=\"text-muted-foreground text-sm\">Downloads</div>\r\n */}\r\n      {\r\n        game.note && (\r\n          <div className=\"bg-yellow-500/10 rounded-2xl\">\r\n            <div className=\"p-4\">\r\n              <h3 className=\"text-yellow-400 font-bold text-sm\">{game.note}</p>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Related Games */}\r\n      {\r\n        allGames.length > 0 && (() => {\r\n          const gameCategory = game.category\r\n\r\n          // Score each game by genre + feature overlap\r\n          const scored = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .map(g => {\r\n              const gGenres = g.genres || []\r\n              const gFeatures = (g.keyFeatures?.filter(Boolean) || g.features || [])\r\n                .map((f: string) => f.toLowerCase())\r\n              const genreScore = gGenres.filter((genre: string) => gameGenres.includes(genre)).length * 2\r\n              const featureScore = gFeatures.filter((f: string) =>\r\n                gameFeatures.some(mf => mf.includes(f) || f.includes(mf))\r\n              ).length\r\n              return { ...g, score: genreScore + featureScore }\r\n            })\r\n            .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)\r\n\r\n          const related = scored.slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          // Top in same category by rating\r\n          const topInCategory = allGames\r\n            .filter(g => g.id !== game.id && g.category === gameCategory)\r\n            .sort((a, b) => (Number(b.rating) || 0) - (Number(a.rating) || 0))\r\n            .slice(0, 10)\r\n\r\n          if (related.length === 0 && topInCategory.length === 0) return null\r\n\r\n          const GameCard = ({ g, index }: { g: any; index?: number }) => (\r\n            <Link key={g.id} href={`/game/${g.id}`} className=\"group flex-shrink-0 w-28 sm:w-32\">\r\n              <div className=\"relative aspect-[3/4] rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#1a103c]\">\r\n                <img\r\n                  src={g.image || \"/placeholder.svg\"}\r\n                  alt={g.title}\r\n                  className=\"w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-300      </div>\r\n                )}\r\n                <div className={`absolute ${index !== undefined && index < 3 ? from-black/80 via-transparent to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\" />\r\n                <div className=\"absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300\">\r\n                  <p className=\"text-white text-[10px] font-medium line-clamp-2\">{g.title}</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              </div>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1.5 line-clamp-1 group-hover:text-[#9d4edd] transition-colors\">{g.title}</p>\r\n            </Link>\r\n          )\r\n\r\n          return (\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-6\">\r\n              {related.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex      )}\r\n\r\n              {topInCategory.length > 0 && (\r\n                <div>\r\n                  <h2 className=\"text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2\">\r\n                    <span className=\"w-1 h-6 bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" />\r\n                    Top {gameCategory === \"Android Games\" ? \"Android\" : \"PC\"} Games\r\n                  </h2>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-hide\">\r\n                    {topInCategory.map((g, i) => <GameCard key={g.id} g={g} index={i} />)}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              )}\r\n            </div>\r\n          )\r\n        })()\r\n      }\r\n\r\n      {/* Ratings & Reviews Section - Always visible */}\r\n      <div className=\"bg-card rounded-2xl\">\r\n        <div className=\"p-6 pb-0\">\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2\">\r\n            <h3 className=\"text-foreground font-bold Approval\r\n                </span>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={withdrawReview}\r\n    </button>\r\n              )}\r\n              {userReview?.status === 'pending' && (\r\n                <button\r\n                  onClick={updateReview}\r\n                  className=\"px-3         )}\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold transition-colors ${\r\n                  userReview && userReview.status !== 'pending'\r\n                    ? 'bg-green-500/20 border border-green-500/50 text-green-400 hover:bg-green-500/30' \r\n                    : 'bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white'\r\n                }`}\r\n              >\r\n                {userReview ? `Rated: ${userReview.rating} ★` : 'Write a Review'}\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        </div>\r\n        \r\n        {reviews.length > 0 ? (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 space-y-4\">\r\n            {/* Average */}\r\n            <div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 p-4 bg-white/5 rounded-xl\">\r\n              <div className=\"text-center\">\r\n                <p className=\"text-4xl font-black text-white\">{(reviews.reduce((s, r) => s + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length).toFixed(1)}</p>\r\n                <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-1 justify-center\">\r\n                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-4 h-4 ${s <= Math.round(reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length) ? 's' : ''}</p>\r\n                {userReview && (\r\n                  <div className=\"mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/10\">\r\n                    <p className=\"text-green-400 text-xs font-medium\">Your Rating: {userReview.rating} ★</p>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                )}\r\n              </div>\r\n              <div className=\"flex-1 space-y-1\">\r\n                {[5, 4, 3, 2, 1].map(star => {\r\n                  const count = reviews.filter(r => r.rating === star).length\r\n                  const pct = reviews.length ? rounded-full h-1.5 overflow-hidden\">\r\n                        <div className=\"h-full bg-yellow-500 rounded-full\" style={{ width: `${pct}%` }} />\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-500 w-6 text-right\">{count}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                  )\r\n                })}\r\n              </div>\r\n            </div>\r\n            {/* Individual reviews */}\r\n            <div className=\"space-y-3\">\r\n                {reviews.map(r => (\r\n                  <div key={r.id} className=\"bg-[#1a103c] border                  <div className=\"w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-[#9d4edd]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-white text-xs font-bold\">{r.user_name?.charAt(0)}</div>\r\n                        <div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap\">\r\n                            <p className=\"text-white text-sm font-semibold\">{r.user_name}</p>\r\n                            {r.user_badge && (\r\n                              <span className={`inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold border ${r.user_badge_color || 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-400 border-gray-500/30'}`}>\r\n                                {r.user_badge}\r\n                              </span>\r\n                            )}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                          <div className=\"flex gap-0.5 mt-0.5\">\r\n                            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className={`w-3 h-3 ${s <= r.rating ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />)}\r\n                          </div>\r\n                        </div>\r\n                      </div>\r\n                      <span className=\"text-gray-600 text-xs\">{new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</span>\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {r.content && <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm leading-relaxed\">{r.content}</p>}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                ))}\r\n              </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        ) : (\r\n          <div className=\"p-6 text-center\">\r\n            <div className=\"py-8\">\r\n              <Star className=\"w-12 h-12 text-gray-600 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-lg font-medium mb-2\">No reviews yet</p>\r\n              <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mb-4\">Be the first to share your experience!</p>\r\n              <button\r\n                onClick={() => setShowReviewModal(true)}\r\n                className=\"px-6 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white transition-colors\"\r\n              >\r\n                Write a Review\r\n              </button>\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n        )}\r\n      </div>\r\n\r\n      {/* Comments */}\r\n      <Comments gameId={game.id} itemName={game.title} />\r\n\r\n      {/* Review Modal */}\r\n      {\r\n        showReviewModal && (\r\n          <div className=\"fixed inset-0 z-[200] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center p-4\" onClick={() =>    {!user ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-4 space-y-3\">\r\n                  <Star className=\"w-10 h-10 text-yellow-500 mx-auto\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-300 text-sm\">Sign in to write a review</p>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex gap-3 justify-center\">\r\n                    <a href=\"/login\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-white text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors\">Log in</a>\r\n                    <a href=\"/signup\" className=\"px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#9d4edd] hover:bg-[#7b2cbf] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-colors\">Sign up</a>\r\n                  </div>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : reviewDone ? (\r\n                <div className=\"text-center py-6\">\r\n                  <CheckCircle className=\"w-12 h-12 text-green-400 mx-auto mb-3\" />\r\n                  <p className=\"text-green-400 font-bold text-lg\">Review submitted!</p>\r\n                  <p className=\"text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1\">It will appear after admin approval.</p>\r\n                </div>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"space-y-5\">\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <p className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-3 text-center\">How would you rate this game?</p>\r\n                    <div className=\"flex justify-center gap-2\">\r\n                      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                        <button key={s} type=\"button\"\r\n                          onMouseEnter={() => setReviewHover(s)} onMouseLeave={() => setReviewHover(0)}\r\n                          onClick={() => setReviewRating(s)}\r\n                          className=\"transition-transform hover:scale-125\">\r\n                          <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${s <= (reviewHover || reviewRating) ? 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />\r\n                        </button>\r\n                      ))}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {reviewRating > 0 && (\r\n                      <p className=\"text-center text-sm mt-2 font-semibold\" style={{ color: ['', '#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'][reviewRating] }}>\r\n                        {['', 'Terrible', 'Poor', 'Average', 'Good', 'Excellent'][reviewRating]}\r\n                      </p>\r\n                    )}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1.5 block\">Share your experience <span className=\"text-gray-600\">(optional)</span></label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reviewContent} onChange={e => setReviewContent(e.target.value)} rows={4}\r\n                      placeholder=\"What did you think about this game? />\r\n            <div className=\"absolute top-3 right-3 px-2 py-1 bg-yellow-500/90 text-black text-xs font-bold rounded\">\r\n              v{game.version || '1.0'}\r\n            </div>\r\n          </div>\r\n          {/* Like/Dislike/Rate Buttons Below Cover - Always visible */}\r\n          <div className=\"flex items-center gap-2 mt-4\">\r\n            <button\r\n              onClick={() => === 'like' \r\n                  ? 'bg-green-500/20 border-green-500/50 text-green-400' \r\n                  : 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-muted-foreground hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-foreground'\r\n              }`}\r\n            >\r\n              <ThumbsUp className={`w-4 h-4 ${userReaction === 'like' ? (\r\n                <>\r\n                  <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\r\n                    {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => (\r\n                      <Star key={s} className={`w-4 h-4 ${s <= Math.round(reviews.reduce((a, r) => a + r.rating, 0) / reviews.length) ?           </>\r\n              ) : (\r\n                <div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\">\r\n                  {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(s => <Star key={s} className=\"w-4 h-4 text-muted <a\r\n                                        key={li}\r\n                                        href={link.url}\r\n                                        target=\"_blank\"\r\n                                        rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\r\n                                        className=\"flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-2 bg-black/20 rounded-lg hover:bg-black/40      <Download className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${style.color} flex-shrink-0`} />\r\n                                          <span className=\"text-white text-sm truncate\">{link.name || `Part ${li + 'text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500' : 'text-gray-600'}`} />\r\n                        </button>\r\n                      ))}\r\n                    </div>\r\n                    {reviewRating > 0 && (\r\n                      <p className=\"text-center text-sm mt-2 font-semibold\" style={{ color: ['', '#ef4444', '#f97316', '#eab308', '#84cc16', '#22c55e'][reviewRating] }}>\r\n                        {['', 'Terrible', 'Poor', 'Average', 'Good', 'Excellent'][reviewRating]}\r\n                      </p>\r\n                    )}\r\n                  </div>\r\n                  <div>\r\n                    <label className=\"text-gray-400 text-sm mb-1.5 block\">Share your experience <span className=\"text-gray-600\">(optional)</span></label>\r\n                    <textarea value={reviewContent} onChange={e => setReviewContent(e.target.value)} rows={4}\r\n                      placeholder=\"What did you think about this game? className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] text-white rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm outline-none focus:border-[#9d4edd]\">\r\n                      <option value=\"error\">Download                     placeholder=\"Describe the issue...\"\r\n                      className=\"w-full bg-[#1a103c] border border-[#2d1b54] focus:border-[#9d4edd] rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-white               "filePath": "C:\\wd\\Rovo Dev\\web2\\components\\game-details.tsx",
              "oldString": "  // ESC key closes lightbox\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (e.key === 'Escape') setLightboxOpen(false)\n    }\n    if (lightboxOpen) {\n      document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)\n      return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)\n    }\n  }, [lightboxOpen])\n  const recommendPercent = Math.min(95, Math.max(70, averageRating * 20))",
              "newString": "  // ESC key closes lightbox\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {\n      if (e.key === 'Escape') { setLightboxOpen(false); setShowReviewModal(false) }\n    }\n    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)\n    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown)\n  }, [])\n\n  // Load reviews\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!game?.id) return\n    const headers: Record<string, string> = {}\n    if (token) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`\n    fetch(`/api/reviews?game_id=${game.id}`, { headers })\n      .then(r => r.json())\n      .then(d => {\n        if (d.reviews) setReviews(d.reviews)\n        if (d.userPendingReview) setUserReview({ ...d.userPendingReview, status: 'pending' })\n      })\n      .catch(() => {})\n  }, [game?.id, token])\n\n  // Load reactions\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!game?.id || !token) return\n    fetch(`/api/reactions?game_id=${game.id}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })\n      .then(r => r.json())\n      .then(d => { if (d.userReaction) setUserReaction(d.userReaction) })\n      .catch(() => {})\n  }, [token, game?.id])\n\n  const handleReaction = async (reaction: 'like' | 'dislike') => {\n    if (!user) { setShowReactionLoginPrompt(true); setTimeout(() => setShowReactionLoginPrompt(false), 3000); return }\n    const res = await fetch('/api/reactions', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` }, body: JSON.stringify({ gameId: game.id, reaction }) })\n    const data = await res.json()\n    if (data.success) setUserReaction(data.userReaction)\n  }\n\n  const recommendPercent = Math.min(95, Math.max(70, averageRating * 20))"
            },
